content.title: Contained-Route Rule Break | Handcraft, Window Release, Open-Sky Message
content.summary: A copper paper glider leaves a river tram and unfolds into one question. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: A lightweight object is visibly made inside a contained carrier. + One clear boundary crossing separates carrier and free object. + Both routes remain readable during the handoff. + The free object preserves its physical identity across open space. + The terminal message belongs to the object and precedes unrelated promotion.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show two adult hands folding one small copper paper glider inside an original river tram. Track the glider beside the tram for one beat, then let it rise onto an independent route above the river. Unfold the glider into one note with the exact original question WHERE WOULD YOU BEGIN? and end before any interface or product promotion.
